heroSummary: The GCPS 2027–28 school year begins Wednesday, August 4, 2027, and ends Wednesday, May 24, 2028. Fall Break is October 11–15, Thanksgiving Break is November 22–26, Winter Break is December 20–31, and Spring Break is April 3–7. January 3 is a student holiday, and the second semester begins January 4. GCPS schedules two planned Digital Learning Days and separate early-release dates for elementary, middle, and high school students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is GCPS Winter Break, and when do students return in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3, 2028, is a teacher planning and staff development day and student holiday; students begin the second semester Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: How many Digital Learning Days are on the GCPS 2027–28 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The approved calendar lists two Digital Learning Days: September 17, 2027, and March 17, 2028. Check GCPS guidance and your school's announcements for participation details.

calendarFaqs.q: Are GCPS early-release dates the same for every grade level in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Elementary and middle schools release early on October 27–28 and March 1–2. High schools release early for exams on December 15–17 and May 22–24. The approved calendar does not publish dismissal times.

calendarFaqs.q: Does GCPS publish translated calendars for 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. GCPS publishes Chinese, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese editions of the approved 2027–28 calendar in addition to the English version.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families check for GCPS 2027–28 calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official GCPS calendar page and your school's announcements for the latest schedule changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the GCPS 2027–28 calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Download the MySchoolDates 2027–28 ICS file and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. This is a one-time import and will not update automatically if GCPS revises the calendar.

customSections.label: Changes from the 2026–27 Calendar
customSections.content: Compared with 2026–27, GCPS starts one day earlier and ends two days earlier. Fall Break also moves one day earlier, the district schedules two Digital Learning Days instead of three, and students return from Winter Break one day earlier.
